faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: The essentials on signing up, profile verification and scouting days. A question that isn't here? Write to us.

items.q: Who is Ifriqiya Soccer Star for?
items.a: For young players who want to be seen, and for football professionals — recruiters, clubs, academies, agents — looking for talent. Both sign up from the same app, along separate paths.

A scouting day run by a verified professional — club, academy, recruiter or agent — and reviewed by the academy before it is published. Its page shows the date, venue, places, any fee and the eligibility criteria. You sign up from the app, and after the day the organiser can send you an evaluation on six axes.
Creating a player profile is free. Some scouting days carry a registration fee, shown on the event page. Professionals have subscription plans that depend on how widely they search for players.

Every profile is reviewed by the academy's administration: identity, supporting document and, for minors, the consent of a legal guardian. Until that check is done, the profile does not appear in recruiters' searches.

items.q: I am a minor, can I sign up?
items.a: Yes, with a legal guardian's agreement. Their identity and consent are requested during registration and verified before the account is approved.
Only approved professional accounts can start a conversation. You can block someone or report an exchange at any time: moderation reviews every report.

items.q: Which phones does the app run on?
items.a: On iOS and on Android. The account is the same from one device to the next: your videos, your photos and your registrations follow you.

privacyPage.metaDescription: What data Ifriqiya Soccer Star processes, why, who can access it and how to exercise your rights.
privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.lead: Ifriqiya Soccer Star connects football players with recruiters, clubs, academies and agents. This page explains what data we process, why, who can access it and how to exercise your rights.
privacyPage.controllerTodo: Legal name, legal form, registered address, registration number and contact email address. Without these, the document remains legally incomplete.
dataRows: Email address, password (stored in irreversibly hashed form)
Last name, first name, phone number
Determine which features you can access
Date you accepted the terms and this policy
Show the interface in your language
privacyPage.dataGoogle: If you use “Continue with Google”, Google sends us your email address, your name and your Google profile picture. We never receive your Google password.
dataOthers: Date of birth, nationality, country and city, height, weight, strong foot, main and secondary position, level, current club or free-agent status, free-text presentation, profile photo, and the photos and videos you add.
Account type, organisation name, role, country and city, photo, and the supporting documents uploaded for account validation.
The identity documents you submit and, where applicable, information about a minor's legal guardian. They are stored in a private area, accessible only to the administrators in charge of validation.
The content of your messages, their attachments, your voice messages, read timestamps and your last activity.
Your registrations, your attendance, and the assessments written by the organiser (scores out of 100 and a comment).
Posts, comments, likes, follows, and the record of professionals viewing your profile.

A notification identifier specific to your device, the device type and name, and the logs required to keep the service secure. When you use “My location” on a Scout Day map, your position is used on the device only and is not stored on our servers.

When a registration or a subscription is paid: the amount, the currency, the payment method, the settlement status and, where applicable, the transaction reference. No online payment provider is connected to date — payments are recorded by the administration — so we never receive a card number or banking credentials.
whyItems: Providing the service: creating your account, showing your profile to recruiters, enabling messaging and Scout Day registrations.
Verification duty: checking players' identity and professionals' credentials before opening sensitive features to them.
Security and moderation: preventing fraud, abuse and harassment, and handling reports.
Your consent: notifications, camera, microphone and gallery — each one refusable and revocable in your phone's settings.
visibilityItems: A validated player's profile can be viewed by validated professionals. You can make your profile invisible at any time from the app.
Your posts, comments, likes and your follower and following lists are visible to signed-in users.
Your last activity is only visible to someone you already have a conversation with.
A Scout Day assessment is only visible to the assessed player if the organiser chooses to publish it.
privacyPage.moderationBody1: Private messages are encrypted at rest on our servers, and the administration area does not display them: a report is reviewed on the reason written by the person reporting, never on the content of the conversation.
privacyPage.moderationBody2: Reporting someone from the messaging screen therefore passes on to moderation the reason, the conversation's identifier and those of its participants — enough to review the report and, where warranted, suspend an account, without opening your exchanges.
providersRows: “Continue with Google” sign-in, if you use it
Anti-bot protection on the sign-in and sign-up screens
Map tiles for Scout Day locations
Playback of videos added as links
privacyPage.providersNote: These providers act on our behalf and may, depending on where they operate, process data outside your country of residence. Loading a map tile or a YouTube video exposes your IP address to the provider concerned.
privacyPage.providersNoSale: We do not sell your data and we do not pass it to advertisers.
privacyPage.hostingTodo: State the hosting region of the database and, if data leaves Tunisia or the European Union, the transfer mechanism relied upon.
privacyPage.retentionTodo: This point has not been decided yet. The following must be set and then written here: how long an inactive account is kept, how long messages are kept, how long identity documents are kept after validation (the usual practice being to delete them as soon as verification is done), and how long reports and moderation logs are kept. A stated period is a commitment: do not invent one.
privacyPage.minorsTodo: The app is aimed at young players and may receive sign-ups from minors. The following must be defined and then described here: the minimum age, how a legal guardian's consent is obtained, and any messaging restrictions between an adult and a minor.
privacyPage.rightsBody1: You can request access to your data, its correction, its erasure, its portability, as well as restriction of or objection to its processing. You can also withdraw at any time the permissions you granted (notifications, camera, microphone, gallery) from your phone's settings.
privacyPage.rightsBody2: Some of these rights can be exercised directly in the app: edit your profile, make it invisible, delete your photos, videos and posts.
privacyPage.contactTodo: Dedicated email address for data requests, response time, and the authority to lodge a complaint with (in Tunisia: the Instance Nationale de Protection des Données Personnelles). Also settle on a single domain: the app shows an address at @ifriqiyastar.com while the domain verified for sending email is ifriqiya-soccer.com.
privacyPage.securityBody: Traffic to our servers is encrypted in transit. Private messages are encrypted at rest. Identity documents, professional supporting documents and messaging attachments are stored in private, access-restricted areas. No system is infallible, so use a unique password and report any suspicious behaviour to us.
privacyPage.changesBody: This policy may change. If a change is significant, we will tell you in the app. The date at the top of this page shows the last update.
privacyPage.emailsBody1: Two kinds of email leave our servers. Service emails — password reset, security notices, address confirmation — are part of how your account works and are sent to you for as long as it exists. Announcements — a new scouting day, platform news — are sent by the Ifriqiya Soccer Star administration to your account's address.
privacyPage.emailsBody2: Every announcement carries an unsubscribe link of your own: following it records your refusal and no further announcement is sent to you, while service emails continue. You may also write to desabonnement@ifriqiya-soccer.com. We never hand your address to advertisers.
privacyPage.cookiesBody: The site and the administration area set only necessary cookies: the one that keeps you signed in, and the one that remembers your chosen language. No advertising cookie, no tracker, no audience measurement tool — neither on the site nor in the app. Clearing them from your browser signs you out and restores the default language; nothing else is lost.
privacyPage.siteBody: The site can be browsed without an account and without identifying yourself. If you write through the contact form, the name, email address and message you enter reach us by email so that we can reply: they serve no other purpose and feed no mailing list.

termsPage.metaDescription: The rules for using Ifriqiya Soccer Star: sign-up, account validation, content, messaging, Scout Days and termination.
termsPage.title: Terms
termsPage.lead: By creating an account on Ifriqiya Soccer Star, you accept the rules below. They complement the privacy policy, which describes how your data is processed.
termsPage.operatorTodo: Legal name, legal form, registered address, registration number and contact email address — the same details as in the privacy policy.
termsPage.serviceBody1: Ifriqiya Soccer Star connects football players with recruiters, clubs, academies and agents. A player builds a sporting profile, adds videos and photos to it, and can register for scouting days (Scout Days). A professional searches profiles, views them and can get in touch.
termsPage.serviceBody2: We provide a platform that puts people in contact. We are not an agent, not an employer, and not a party to any agreement you reach with a club, an academy or an agent met through it.
accountItems: You undertake to provide accurate information and to keep it up to date. An inaccurate sporting profile distorts recruiters' work.
Your account is personal. You are responsible for keeping it confidential and for everything that happens on it.
A player account is verified with an identity document; a professional account with supporting documents. Until that verification succeeds, some features remain closed.
We may refuse, suspend or close an account whose information is false, whose documents cannot be verified, or which breaches these rules.
termsPage.ageTodo: The minimum sign-up age and the way a minor's legal guardian's consent is obtained have not been settled yet. They must be defined and then written here, consistently with the “Minors” section of the privacy policy.
conductItems: Impersonating someone else, or claiming a professional capacity you do not have.
Posting hateful, violent, sexual or defamatory content, or content that invades someone's privacy.
Harassing, threatening or persistently soliciting another user, in particular a minor.
Posting content you do not hold the rights to, notably match footage belonging to a third party.
Scraping the service's data, circumventing its technical limits, or disrupting its operation.
termsPage.contentBody1: Your photos, videos, posts and messages remain yours. You only grant us the right to host and display them within the service so that it works: showing your profile to a recruiter, playing a video, delivering a message.
termsPage.contentBody2: You warrant that you hold the rights to what you post, and that you have the agreement of any identifiable people appearing in it.
termsPage.moderationBody1: Any content and any account can be reported from the app. We may hide content while a report is being handled, then restore or remove it.
termsPage.moderationBody2: Reporting someone from the messaging screen makes that conversation readable by moderation: it is the only way to handle a harassment report. The detail is in the privacy policy.
termsPage.scoutDaysBody: A Scout Day is organised by a professional, who sets its date, place, capacity and eligibility criteria. You can only register if your profile meets those criteria. The organiser may confirm, refuse, mark attendance and write an assessment; they choose whether to publish it to the assessed player.
termsPage.scoutDaysNote: We do not organise these days and we do not guarantee that they will take place, what they will contain, or what follows from them.
termsPage.moneyTodo: Paid plans are not open. Prices, currencies, taxes, Scout Day commissions, renewal, expiry, cancellation and refunds are still to be defined, as is compliance with Apple's and Google's in-app purchase rules. This section must be written before payment goes live.
termsPage.terminationBody: You may stop using the service at any time and ask for your account to be deleted. We may suspend or close an account that breaches these rules, and we will tell you unless the law forbids it. How long data is kept after closure is set out in the privacy policy.
termsPage.liabilityBody: The service is provided as is. We do what is needed to keep it available and secure, without being able to guarantee it will never be interrupted or contain errors. We are not responsible for recruitment decisions, for agreements reached between users, or for one user's behaviour towards another.
termsPage.ipBody: The name Ifriqiya Soccer Star, its logo, its visual identity and the service itself are protected. These terms transfer no rights in them to you.
termsPage.lawTodo: Governing law, competent courts, and any required prior amicable resolution step. To be settled by a lawyer.
termsPage.changesBody: These terms may change. If a change is significant, we will tell you in the app. The date at the top of this page shows the last update; continuing to use the service means accepting the version in force.

deletionPage.metaDescription: How to request deletion of your Ifriqiya Soccer Star account and the associated data: the procedure, what is erased, what is kept and for how long.
deletionPage.title: Delete your
deletionPage.lead: This page is for users of the Ifriqiya Soccer Star app. It explains how to request deletion of your account and the associated data, from the app or by email, then what is erased, what is kept and for how long.
deletionPage.appIntro: This is the fastest route, and it is available at any time.
appSteps: Open the Ifriqiya Soccer Star app and sign in.
Open the “Profile” tab, then tap “Delete my account”.
Read what will be erased and what will be kept, then tick the confirmation box.
Enter the email address and password of your account. If you sign in with Google, no password is asked for.
deletionPage.appAfter: Your account is deactivated immediately: your profile disappears from searches, nobody can message you any more, and your sessions are closed. At this stage nothing has been erased yet.
deletionPage.mailTitle: By email, if you no longer have the app
deletionPage.mailBody1: Write to us from the email address of your account, with “Account deletion” as the subject:
deletionPage.mailBody2: We check that the request really comes from the account holder, then we start the same procedure: immediate deactivation, permanent erasure thirty days later. You receive a confirmation by email.
deletionPage.graceBody1: Thirty days pass between your request and the erasure. This delay exists to let you change your mind.
deletionPage.graceBody2: Sign back in to the app before the deadline and the deletion is cancelled: your profile is restored exactly as you left it, including if it was hidden. After that deadline the erasure is permanent and nothing can be restored.
deletionPage.erasedIntro: On the deadline, the following data is deleted from our servers:
erasedItems: your profile and everything you entered in it;
your photos, your videos, your CV, your professional supporting documents and the identity document submitted for verification;
your messages and their attachments — the conversation disappears from your correspondent's inbox;
your posts, your comments and your likes;
your follows, your favourites, the records of who viewed your profile, and your notifications;
your access: your email address becomes available again for a new registration.
deletionPage.keptIntro: Three things survive the erasure, because they concern other people or a moderation obligation. They no longer carry your name and contain none of your personal data.
keptRows: They took place and their participants appear in them. An event still to come is cancelled at the moment of erasure, and every registered player is notified.
They are the scores of players who remain registered: erasing them would delete someone else's data.
Kept for as long as moderation needs to handle them.
deletionPage.keptNote: In a conversation, only your messages are erased: those written by your correspondent belong to them and are not destroyed. The thread nevertheless disappears from their inbox.
deletionPage.partialTitle: Deleting only part of your data
deletionPage.partialIntro: You do not have to delete your account to erase a specific piece of data. From the app you can, at any time:
partialItems: delete a photo or a video, the file included;
delete a post or a comment: it disappears from the feed for everyone;
correct or clear the information in your profile;
make your profile invisible in professionals' searches, without deleting anything.
deletionPage.partialStepsIntro: To have a piece of data deleted that the app does not let you erase yourself, the request is made by email:
partialSteps: Write to us from the email address of your account, with “Data deletion” as the subject.
Tell us which data is concerned: a photo, a video, a post, a field of your profile, your messages, your supporting documents.
We check that the request really comes from the account holder, then we delete that data and confirm it to you by email. Your account itself stays open.
deletionPage.partialNote: A deleted post or comment is no longer displayed anywhere. A trace is kept for as long as a possible report needs to be handled, then removed along with your account if you delete it.
deletionPage.retentionBody: Beyond the erasure, we keep only what a legal obligation, a dispute or an ongoing moderation procedure requires us to keep, and only for the required period.
deletionPage.retentionTodo: The retention period required by the applicable accounting and tax rules must be settled and written here, together with that of reports and moderation logs. An announced period is a commitment: invent nothing.
deletionPage.contactBody: For any question about this procedure or about how we process your data, write to us. The detail of the data we process is in our privacy policy.

items.name: Yassine
items.quote: I kept my match videos on my phone without knowing what to do with them. Building my profile taught me how to show my game and my strengths. Above all, my first Scout Day gave me one thing: the urge to aim higher.

items.name: Karim
items.quote: After a scouting day, I finally had concrete feedback on my game. I went back to training with precise goals: my positioning, my runs, my final ball. Every session had a purpose and I saw my progress differently.

items.name: Mehdi
items.quote: A profile does not replace the pitch, but it can open the conversation. The videos let me discover players outside my usual network. Then a scouting day gave us the time to watch them play and to talk.
